function.description:
Retrieves a single global IP address pool by UUID (globalIpAddressPoolId).

PRECEDENCE
Apply sections in order. Higher sections override lower sections when they conflict.

S0 Scope and hard boundaries
S0.1 ID-only global-pool detail tool.
S0.2 Use only for single global pool detail/configuration retrieval.
S0.3 Do not use this tool for count/list questions.
S0.4 Do not use this tool for subpool retrieval.

S1 Invocation rules
S1.1 Required precondition: globalIpAddressPoolId must be a valid UUID.
S1.2 If identifier is UUID-shaped, call this tool directly.
S1.3 If identifier is a name/non-UUID, resolve via api_retrievesGlobalIPAddressPools and answer from resolved result; do not call this tool with name.
S1.4 If user explicitly asks for a global pool, do not retrieve subpools unless explicitly requested.

S2 Detail semantics and calculations
S2.1 Global pools that are not empty may contain subpools and/or directly assigned IP addresses.
S2.2 Available addresses formula:
  available = totalAddresses - (unassignableAddresses + assignedAddresses + defaultAssignedAddresses)
S2.3 Netmask/CIDR guidance: a netmask defines network bits; convert netmask to slash prefix by counting 1-bits; present subnet+mask as CIDR when both exist.

S3 Output format
S3.1 Single global pool detail output must not use a Table.
S3.2 Preferred shape for multi-field detail output: [Markdown intro, KeyValueSet, Markdown summary].
S3.3 If KeyValueSet is used, include Markdown context (no widget-only output).
S3.4 Single global pool detail template (mandatory field order; missing values must be 'N/A'):
  Global pool details
  Name:
  Pool type:
  IPv4 address space:
  Gateway IP:
  DHCP servers:
  DNS servers:
  Total addresses:
  Unassignable addresses:
  Assigned addresses:
  Default assigned addresses:
  Overlapping status:

S4 Prohibitions
S4.1 Do not call this tool with names/non-UUID identifiers.
S4.2 This tool is detail-only; do not use for count questions.
function.name: api_retrievesAGlobalIPAddressPool

id.description: The `id` of the global IP address pool to retrieve.

assignedAddresses.description: The number of addresses assigned from the pool. This is a numeric string; since IPv6 address spaces are 128 bits in size, presume this string has a value up to 128 bits for IPv6 address spaces and 32 bits for IPv4 address spaces.

defaultAssignedAddresses.description: The number of addresses that are assigned from the pool by default. This is a numeric string; since IPv6 address spaces are 128 bits in size, presume this string has a value up to 128 bits for IPv6 address spaces and 32 bits for IPv4 address spaces.

dhcpServers.description: The DHCP server(s) for this subnet.

dnsServers.description: The DNS server(s) for this subnet.

gatewayIpAddress.description: The gateway IP address for this subnet.

prefixLength.description: The network mask component, as a decimal, for the CIDR notation of this subnet.

subnet.description: The IP address component of the CIDR notation for this subnet.

totalAddresses.description: The total number of addresses in the pool. This is a numeric string; since IPv6 address spaces are 128 bits in size, presume this string has a value up to 128 bits for IPv6 address spaces and 32 bits for IPv4 address spaces.

unassignableAddresses.description: The number of addresses in the pool that cannot be assigned. This is a numeric string; since IPv6 address spaces are 128 bits in size, presume this string has a value up to 128 bits for IPv6 address spaces and 32 bits for IPv4 address spaces.

id.description: The UUID for this global IP pool.

name.description: The name for this reserve IP pool. Only letters, numbers, '-' (hyphen), '_' (underscore), '.' (period), and '/' (forward slash) are allowed.

poolType.description: Once created, a global pool type cannot be changed. Tunnel: Assigns IP addresses to site-to-site VPN for IPSec tunneling. Generic: used for all other network types.
